next_step: Finalize POC infra template and cost model, confirm EU/UK residency SLA
notes: Customer: mid-sized legal-tech SaaS serving UK/EU law firms; strict residency requirements.
Primary ask: low-latency enterprise search across 200M+ documents (contracts, precedents).
Indexing scale: target ~220M docs, embeddings footprint estimated 7-10TB (dense float32 -> will propose quantized variants).
Traffic profile: baseline 120 QPS search, peaks to 500-700 QPS during batch events; burst-tolerant routing needed.
Latency target: in-region P95 < 120ms for cold queries, < 80ms with KV/prefix caching; rerank stage must not exceed additional 30-40ms P95.
Cost target: aiming for < $0.01 per full rerank query (embedding + rerank) at scale; highly cost sensitive.
Preferred models: customer open to Llama-family quantized variants and 7B/13B mixes for rerank; wants Redwood to recommend quantization profile.
Routing/failover: primary EU-west region (Frankfurt), secondary eu-north (Stockholm), UK-residency option for specific clients; automatic multi-region failover required.
Security: must support SSO/SAML, KMS with HSM-backed keys, retention controls per client, audit logs forwarded to customer SIEM.
Quote from head of infra: "No data leaves EU/UK. We will not accept US processing for PII-bearing docs."
POC scope agreed: 6-week eval. Week 1: ingest 10M docs sample; Week 2-3: embeddings + ANN tuning; Week 4: reranker integration and latency tuning; Week 5-6: scale tests and runbook handoff.
Preferred deployment: Dedicated capacity for steady baseline + Private (VPC) for regulated customers. Will evaluate Dedicated throughput guarantees vs Private for on-prem audit clients.
Decision factors: residency + audit trail > raw model quality; unit economics second but critical at 200M index size.
Internal contacts: CTO - Laura Bennett, Head of IR - Simon Greaves (legal), Procurement - Emma Holt.
AE notes: trial credit applied; sent pricing deck + EU residency FAQ. Asked Redwood to run cost projection for two options: dedicated pooled GPUs vs hybrid private nodes for heavy rerank bursts.
Action items: SE to produce quantization recommendations for embedding store, Redwood to provide estimated egress/replication costs for cross-region failover.
